title: Strict JSON-Schema decoding with packed sm_120 grammar masks
inspiration: DeepInfer structured outputs, re-derived for Strata's Qwen3.8 verifier and GGUF token table.
evidence: CUDA 13.1 Release build for 120-real succeeded for strata and strata-q36. Four CTest targets pass. Isolated 248,320-token mask: 7.337 us kernel-only and 104.321 us pinned upload plus kernel.
acceptance: At least 10,000 outputs over about 20 schemas, zero invalid committed outputs with speculation on and off, at least 95% of unconstrained decode throughput, and GPU mask parity maintained.
constraints: Startup-scoped schema; serial single-GPU stream only; no batch, layer split, pipeline windows, regex, or EBNF.
rollback: Unset STRATA_GRAMMAR_SCHEMA and restart the reference profile; remove the overlay build from the test profile.
